hints.content:
Function $\redD g$ is shifted $1$ unit left relative to $\blueD f$. 



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A parabola f and its shifted graph g are on an x y coordinate plane. The x- and y- axes scale by one. Graph f is concave down and has a vertex around (two, negative one). Graph g is concave down and has a vertex around (one, negative one). An arrow points from (two, negative one) to (one, negative one).

hints.content:
This means the value of $\redD{g}$ at a number $x$ is the same as the value of $\blueD{f}$ at a number $1$ more than $x$. 

  What would this sentence look like as an equation?

question.content:
$\redD g$ is a transformation of $\blueD f$. The graph below shows $\blueD f$ as a solid blue line and $\redD g$ as a dotted red line.
